claim: instance b=7, m=2, g=1 of a three-parameter family from a follow-up post to Rybin's announcement: fractional cost 125, every congestion-good unsplittable routing costs at least 126

source.author: Hensen Juang (@basedjensen), follow-up post to Rybin's announcement
source.note: Unrefereed social-media post, and a different artifact from Rybin's original announcement: it gives a three-parameter (b, m, g) family, of which this fixture is the b=7, m=2, g=1 member. The arcs, costs and demands below are this repository's transcription of that post, not a verified primary source. Confirmed locally by exhaustive enumeration of all 8 unsplittable routings, of which 4 are congestion-good.
